title: DraftChanged
description:
Payload of `sites.draft.changed.v1`: a note in the publications of a site changed in the vault.

A fact. `ratatoskr-sites` publishes it when it consumes a `notes.file.changed.v1` for a note that
a publication of the site selects, and Edge alone reads it to send `draft.changed` to the owner
sessions of the site (workspace design D5). It carries no note content and no vault path; every
other member is refused. The enclosing envelope carries the owner as `tenant_id` and the
aggregate `site:<site_id>`.

revision.description: The lowercase hex SHA-256 of the new bytes of the note.

site_id.description: The site whose publications hold the note.

slug.description: The slug of the note in the current release. Absent when the note is not published.

DigestHex.title: DigestHex
DigestHex.description: Lowercase hexadecimal bytes of a content digest.

SiteId.title: SiteId
SiteId.description:
The id of one site: 3 to 40 lower-case ASCII letters, digits and `-`.

The grammar is the `site:<site id>` form of `WriteOrigin` in `ratatoskr-notes-contracts`.
The owner chooses the id, and it appears in every route under `/v1/sites/{site}/`.

Slug.title: Slug
Slug.description:
The slug of one page: unique in its release, and the last part of
`/v1/sites/{site}/content/pages/{slug}`.

Segments of lower-case ASCII letters, digits and `-`, separated by `/`, at most 1024
characters. The release builder takes the frontmatter key `slug`, or else the vault path
without `.md`, lower-cased, with each run of other characters than ASCII letters, digits
and `/` replaced by one `-` (workspace spec `site-publications`).

SourceRef.title: SourceRef
SourceRef.description:
The opaque reference of one note in the publications of a site.

The sites service mints it, and only a `site_owner` session of the site ever sees it. It
names no vault path. 1 to 128 ASCII letters, digits, `_` and `-`, so it fits one path
segment of `/v1/sites/{site}/drafts/sources/{source_ref}`.
